evidence.summary: Repeated model chunks exhausted the arena because packed views prevented reclaiming temporary regions.

reproduction.instructions: Run the full Atlas model render plan at the pre-fix language revision and inspect the bounded-view region planner outcome.

summary: The pre-fix Atlas full render plan reproduced arena exhaustion after bounded-view region reclamation was suppressed.

workaround.description: No safe Atlas-side workaround; retaining all loop regions only delays the exhaustion and changes the backend memory contract.
